summary: Learn fisheries gender analysis, value-chain mapping and equality action planning. Explore the five-day foundation course and enrol.
lede: Women's equality in the fisheries sector involves examining who works, accesses resources and influences decisions across fisheries activities. For fisheries programme staff, officers and community-facing practitioners, this foundation course offers practical ways to identify participation barriers and plan more inclusive work. You will use a Harvard Analytical Framework, map value-chain roles, develop sex-disaggregated indicators and draft an equality action plan, with introductory attention to digital data and gender-responsive budgeting.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who plan, deliver, monitor or support fisheries activities and need to include women's roles and priorities in day-to-day decisions. It is designed for fisheries professionals who need practical ways to review participation, services, work and programme evidence.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with fisheries work, community livelihoods or fisheries programme responsibilities. No coding is required.
